label: POST HOC (12 Oct 2026; proposed in review; not pre-registered): P7 Apertus promotions vs the no-model exact-date match, paired on the same annotated rows, from committed copies; no registered decision depends on this file
proposed_by: proposed in review (round-20 skeptical-ML review); counted by the team
reading: On the rows both arms promote, Apertus and the no-model match write the gold answer date equally often (106 vs 105 of 112). Apertus's higher precision comes from the rows it declines: the no-model match also promotes 34 annotated rows Apertus does not, every one an answer, 22 of them correctly dated. So the no-model match yields more correctly dated promotions (113 vs 127); Apertus's precision gain is an abstention effect, not a better date.
